issuing_authority.quote: The Construction Industries Board is hereby re-created to continue until July 1, 2026, in accordance with the provisions of the Oklahoma Sunset Law. The Board shall regulate the plumbing, electrical and mechanical trades, the building and construction inspectors, the home inspectors, and the roofing contractors

name.quote: The Construction Industries Board is hereby re-created to continue until July 1, 2026

type.quote: The Board shall regulate the plumbing, electrical and mechanical trades, the building and construction inspectors, the home inspectors, and the roofing contractors through the powers and duties set forth in the Construction Industries Board Act and in the respective licensing or registration acts for such trades

age_minimum.quote: persons who furnish proof satisfactory to the Board that they are sixteen (16) years of age or older and are enrolled in a recognized school or training course for plumber apprentices

required.quote: The Construction Industries Board shall issue licenses to persons who have been certified by the Board as having successfully passed the examination for journeyman plumber or plumbing contractor, as the case may be, and who have paid the fees and have otherwise complied with the applicable requirements

exams.name: Journeyman Plumber / Plumbing Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Uniform, practical, in whole or in part in writing. Regular exams at least twice a year. Failing applicants must wait 30 days before retaking; subsequent failures require 90-day wait.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Construction Industries Board / State Committee of Plumbing Examiners)
exams.quote: Examinations shall be uniform and shall be practical in nature but sufficiently strict to test the qualification and fitness of the applicant as a journeyman plumber or as a plumbing contractor

exams.name: Journeyman Electrician / Electrical Contractor Examination
exams.notes: Uniform and practical, in whole or in part in writing. A passing score is 70% or higher. Failing applicants must wait 30 days before retaking.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Construction Industries Board / Committee of Electrical Examiners)
exams.quote: Examinations for licenses as electrical contractors or journeyman electricians shall be uniform and practical in nature for each respective license and shall be sufficiently strict to test the qualifications and fitness of the applicants for licenses.

exams.name: Mechanical Contractor / Mechanical Journeyman Examination
exams.notes: Uniform, practical, in whole or in part in writing. Quarterly exams minimum. Initial failure: 30-day wait; subsequent failures: 90-day wait.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Construction Industries Board / Committee of Mechanical Examiners)
exams.quote: Examinations for licenses as mechanical contractors or mechanical journeymen shall be uniform and practical in nature for each respective license and shall be sufficiently strict to test the qualifications and fitness of the applicants for licenses.

exams.name: Commercial Roofing Endorsement Examination
exams.notes: Required on and after July 1, 2015. Uniform and practical, in whole or in part in writing. Monthly minimum. Initial failure: 30-day wait; subsequent failures: 90-day wait.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Construction Industries Board / Committee of Roofing Examiners)
exams.quote: every roofing contractor offering to engage in or engaging in performing commercial roofing contractor work in this state shall be required to take and successfully pass a commercial roofing examination approved under the provisions of this act

exams.name: Residential Roofing Endorsement Examination
exams.notes: Effective July 1, 2026 per Laws 2025, c. 368. Minimum passing score of 70%. Existing registrants have a 12-month grandfathering period. Monthly minimum exams.
exams.jurisdiction: state (Construction Industries Board / Committee of Roofing Examiners)
exams.quote: every roofing contractor, except for those defined in subsection G of this section, offering to engage in or engaging in performing residential roofing contractor work in this state shall be required to receive a residential roofing endorsement. To receive a residential roofing endorsement, the roofing contractor shall be required to take and successfully pass a residential roofing examination approved under the provisions of this act with a minimum score of seventy percent (70%)

interval_years.quote: No license shall be issued for longer than one (1) year and all licenses shall expire on the last day in the birth month of the licensee.

renewal_fee_usd.quote: A renewal fee for a roofing contractor registration shall be Seventy-five Dollars ($75.00) for the annual renewal registration certificate.

required.quote: No journeyman or contractor license shall be renewed unless the licensee has completed the required hours of continuing education as determined and approved by the Committee.

hours_per_period.quote: Effective January 1, 2026, no contractor or journeyman license shall be renewed unless the licensee has completed twelve (12) hours of continuing education every three (3) years or thirty-six (36) months preceding license renewal.

period_years.quote: no contractor or journeyman license shall be renewed unless the licensee has completed twelve (12) hours of continuing education every three (3) years or thirty-six (36) months preceding license renewal.

value: 6 hours of codes and revisions adopted by the Oklahoma Uniform Building Code Commission (OUBCC)

electrical circuit theory and calculations, wiring methods, grounding and bonding, transformer and motor theory, electrical circuits and devices, control systems, alternative energy systems including energy storage, safety related to the electrical industry as defined by NFPA 70E, manufacturers' installation of equipment or parts, the Electrical License Act
topical_requirements.quote: The continuing education material shall cover six (6) hours of codes and revisions adopted by the Oklahoma Uniform Building Code Commission (OUBCC). The remaining six (6) hours may include the study of: electrical circuit theory and calculations, wiring methods, grounding and bonding, transformer and motor theory, electrical circuits and devices, control systems, alternative energy systems including energy storage, safety related to the electrical industry as defined by NFPA 70E, manufacturers' installation of equipment or parts, the Electrical License Act

available.quote: Except as otherwise provided by law, by way of reciprocity and without examination, an application for any license issued by any committee or board under the authority of the Construction Industries Board to engage in any work or trade in this state subject to the Board's regulatory authority may be made to the Board

requirements.value: Applicant must be currently licensed in another state/country/territory with substantially equivalent requirements, must have lawfully practiced the trade for 1 year immediately prior to application, must have no pending disciplinary matters, must have obtained original license by examination, and must meet all other CIB Act requirements including payment of applicable fees.
requirements.quote: The Board may, in its discretion, issue a license by reciprocity to an applicant who is currently licensed to practice an applicable trade in another state, country, territory, province or city outside of the State of Oklahoma, upon a satisfactory showing of the following: 1. That the requirements for licensure in the city, state, country, territory or province in which the applicant is licensed are deemed by the Board to be substantially the same or equivalent to the requirements for obtaining an original license by examination in force in this state

definition_quote.value: Mechanical work means the installation, maintenance, repair, or renovation, in whole or in part, of any heating system, exhaust system, cooling system, mechanical refrigeration system or ventilation system or any equipment or piping carrying chilled water, air for ventilation purposes, or natural gas, or the installation, maintenance, repair, or renovation of process piping used to carry any liquid, substance, or material, including steam and hot water used for space heating purposes not under the jurisdiction of the Department of Labor other than minor repairs to such systems
definition_quote.quote: "Mechanical work" means the installation, maintenance, repair, or renovation, in whole or in part, of any heating system, exhaust system, cooling system, mechanical refrigeration system or ventilation system or any equipment or piping carrying chilled water, air for ventilation purposes, or natural gas, or the installation, maintenance, repair, or renovation of process piping used to carry any liquid, substance, or material, including steam and hot water used for space heating purposes not under the jurisdiction of the Department of Labor other than minor repairs to such systems

methods_authorized.quote: "Plumbing contractor" means any person who is skilled in the planning, superintending, and practical installation of plumbing and who is familiar with the laws and rules governing the same.

registration_number_required_in_ads.quote: A roofing contractor shall display his or her roofing contractor registration number issued pursuant to the Roofing Contractor Registration Act on every business sign, card, correspondence, and contract used to solicit and conduct roofing services in this state

contract_must_be_written.quote: Each registrant shall utilize a valid written contract when engaging in the business of roofing contractor work.
